name: test-once
description: Stop duplicate expensive full-suite runs across Codex sessions, safely reuse exact passing results, and distinguish nominal work from warm-calibrated wall-time savings.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse exact full-suite passes with honest savings.
interface.longDescription: Stop development, review, and parallel Codex sessions from rerunning the same expensive full suite. Test Once reuses only passing results matched by exact source, command, environment, platform, and toolchain fingerprints; single-flight locking collapses concurrent runs; focused tests stay untouched; and local statistics separate nominal avoided test work from optional warm-calibrated wall-time savings, so native runner caches are not mistaken for plugin savings. It works with Go, TypeScript, and any shell-driven test suite without telemetry.
defaultPrompt: Configure Test Once for this repository's full test suite.
Run or reuse the configured full test suite safely.
Show avoided runs and warm-calibrated wall-time savings.
